feed.title: Tampa Defense Firm Joins NYSE After $110M Raise
feed.summary: Tampa-headquartered XTEND AI Robotics, trading as “XTND” on the NYSE, has completed a merger that raised $110 million to expand its manufacturing capabilities. feed.title: Boycott of Starbucks Is Still On as Workers Press for $17 Wage and Protections
feed.summary: Starbucks Workers United is continuing its boycott of the coffee giant this Labor Day weekend, demanding a minimum hourly wage of $17, improved staffing, and better workplace protections. feed.title: A 6,560-foot hole in Cornish granite came up with 158-degree water carrying 100 parts per million of lithium, and a well in the same rock pulls 340. So a small British company hired a Texas oilfield crew to sink two more holes and pump for three months
